description: Find roamflat Flats for a destination (a country in any language, or a 2-letter ISO code). Every Flat is unlimited data up to 10 Mbps with hotspot, priced per day; a country may have several Flats that differ by the networks included. Returns the cheapest per day first with the bookable durations, full facts and a direct link. Use when a user wants mobile data abroad; use recommend_plan when they describe a whole trip.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. "en-gb", "de-de". Wins over language; prices and links are quoted in it.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code. Every price in the result is quoted in it.

destination.description: Country in any language, e.g. "Spain", "Japon", "Türkei", or a 2-letter ISO code. For a city, pass its country.

destinations.description: Several countries for one trip. roamflat sells one Flat per country, so the result lists the Flats of each country (grouped under per_destination) unless a single Flat covers them all. Overrides destination.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Titles, labels and country names come back in it when available. Bare "en" is quoted in en-us / USD.

limit.description: Flats to return. Default 10; all_plans_url lists everything.

min_days.description: Only Flats that offer a duration of at least this many days.

sort.description: price = cheapest per day first (default); networks = most networks first.

name: search_esim_plans

destinations.description: How each requested destination was understood.

from_price.description: Lowest per-day price in this result set, shop-formatted.

iso.description: Resolved ISO code of the (first) destination.

message.description: Present when nothing matched: says why and what to try.

note.description: Present when part of the request could not be honoured.

per_destination.description: Present for several destinations: the Flats of each country, one group per destination.

items.description: One Flat (a family of bookable durations for one country and one set of networks). Every field is present only when the catalogue holds a value for it; an absent field is unknown, never "no".

all_networks.description: True when this is the top Flat of the country: every network the shop offers there.

coverage_countries.description: Every country the Flat works in.

name.description: Country name in the requested language.

coverage_label.description: Human-readable coverage label as the shop shows it (localized).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of every price in this object.

data.description: Always "unlimited": no data allowance on a Flat.

durations.description: Every bookable duration of this Flat, shortest first. Each is bought on its own product page.

price.description: TOTAL price of this duration in currency — the amount paid.

product_id.description: Product id to pass to start_checkout for this duration.

fair_use.description: The official wording to present as returned: "Unlimited data up to 10 Mbps. Enough for everything — maps, video, calls, hotspot." No daily allowance, no reduced speed.

family_id.description: Id shared by every duration of this Flat.

hotspot.description: True: hotspot / tethering is included in every Flat.

last_updated.description: Date the Flat was last updated in the catalogue (YYYY-MM-DD).

network_generation.description: Network generation, e.g. "5G/4G". Never an operator name.

networks.description: The mobile networks the Flat runs on, as the shop states them. The phone picks the strongest included network.

networks_label.description: The shop's own label for the networks, localized: "Vodafone + O2 + EE" or "all 4 networks".

networks_total.description: Number of networks the shop offers in this country. all_networks is true when the Flat includes them all.

plan_note.description: Customer-facing caveat for this Flat in plain words. Present it as returned whenever present.

price.description: Price of ONE DAY in currency (price_basis per_day) — the cheapest per-day rate of this Flat. NOT the price of the plan: quote the matching total from durations.

price_is_final.description: Always true: no tax or fee is added at checkout.

price_max.description: Total price of the longest duration (days_max).

pricing_bucket.description: language-region bucket the prices and links are quoted in, e.g. "en-us".

product_id.description: Product id of the Flat (its shortest duration). Use it for get_plan_details and start_checkout (with days).

rating.description: Average customer rating (1-5). Present only when reviews exist.

review_count.description: Number of reviews. Present only when > 0.

selected_days.description: Present when the requested product_id is one specific duration: its day count.

selected_price.description: Present with selected_days: the total price of that duration.

speed_cap.description: The same in words: "up to 10 Mbps".

speed_cap_mbps.description: Constant speed cap in Mbps (10): the Flat runs at up to this speed for the whole validity.

speed_note.description: Present together with the speed: "up to" is the maximum — the actual speed depends on the local network, the location and how busy the network is. Never promise a constant 10 Mbps.

starts.description: When the days begin: at the first connection in the destination country — not at purchase, not at installation.

summary.description: Short description in the requested language, from the product page.

title.description: Product title in the requested language.

kind.description: Always "none": a Flat ends when its days are over; the next trip is a new Flat.

type.description: Always "Flat" — the brand name of the plan, keep in English.

url.description: Product page in pricing_bucket. Use verbatim.

validity_clock.description: How the days run: 24-hour periods from the first connection.

voice_sms.description: Always "none": data only, no telephone number, no SMS.
